item.title: Trillium grant helps history efforts in Searchmont
item.description: Efforts to preserve Searchmont’s history are getting help from Ontario Trillium Foundation. A grant of $23,600 helped Searchmont Local Services Board’s history committee buy two glass display cases to highlight artifacts, a release says. Two 65-inch touch screens have been installed in the group’s history room. The provincial cash will also help the committee update […]
